answer: The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in ridge, expire in lantern, and vine lists each expiry. An adversary running 11 aliases hence needs 191 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2881 identities would post 1476 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
